items.durable_delta: Distinguish a dataset-defined unlearning/deletion guarantee from output suppression or refusal; compare against a provenance-bearing retrain reference and include derived-capability recovery probes.
items.failure_fallback: When a retrain reference is unaffordable, non-unique, or lacks provenance, label the objective as suppression/editing and do not claim deletion.
items.claim_boundary: Position/evaluation-contract paper only; it does not implement a new unlearning system or establish a general deletion-success rate.
